query: UPDATE accounts SET deleted_at = now() WHERE pid = ANY($1) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contacts c WHERE c.account_pid = accounts.pid AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.account_pid = accounts.pid AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.account_pid = accounts.pid AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partnerships p WHERE p.account_pid = accounts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memberships m WHERE m.account_pid = accounts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities a WHERE a.subject_kind = 'account' AND a.subject_pid = accounts.pid AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attachments x WHERE x.subject_pid = accounts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custom_field_values v WHERE v.subject_pid = accounts.pid)) RETURNING pid
